clue.text: Traffic controller's answer during drinks session

indicators.note: during says the letter for answer sits in the middle of the two words that follow, splitting them

parts.note: a round is a set of drinks bought for the group
a bout is a spell or session of activity, especially drinking

explanation.surface: Someone asks how traffic gets managed and the reply comes mid-way through an evening in the pub.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', joining definition to wordplay; 'drinks session' reads as one idea but splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A circular junction regulates the flow of vehicles without lights, so it controls traffic.

clue.text: Noisy disturbance caused by strange cat with no tail

parts.note: rum is an old-fashioned British word for odd or strange

indicators.note: with no tail says the final letter of the cat word is cut off

parts.note: puss is an informal word for a cat

explanation.surface: An odd cat is blamed for a racket.
explanation.definitionFit: A noisy commotion or uproar, a synonym for a row or fracas.

clue.text: Scruffy new day unit has no answer

indicators.note: new signals the letters are made into a fresh arrangement
has no says a letter is taken out of the fodder before rearranging

explanation.surface: A brand-new day unit somehow lacks a reply and looks shabby.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has no' removes A from DAYUNIT, leaving DYUNIT; 'new' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Both describe something messy and unkempt in appearance; a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Health workers discern trust is broken

indicators.note: broken means smashed apart, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: Health workers can tell when confidence has collapsed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' belongs to the fodder, not a link: all of DISCERN TRUST IS is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Community nurses who visit patients at home are health workers in Britain.

clue.text: Piece on mainly affluent position of a minister

parts.note: a bishop is a chess piece

indicators.note: mainly means most of the word, so its last letter is dropped

parts.note: affluent means rich

explanation.surface: A chess piece sits on the comfortable post of a clergyman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link here; the pieces simply follow each other.
explanation.definitionFit: A see or diocese is the office and territory of a senior Church minister.

clue.text: Accepted practice in America, for example, on the rise

parts.note: USA is the abbreviation for the United States of America

indicators.note: on the rise in a down clue means the letters read upwards, i.e. backwards

parts.note: e.g. abbreviates exempli gratia, Latin for for example

explanation.surface: A custom, for instance, is becoming more common in the States.
explanation.definitionFit: Usage is customary or established practice, as in common usage.

clue.text: West wing must be heated

parts.note: W is the compass abbreviation for west
an arm is a wing or branch, as of a building or organisation

explanation.surface: An instruction that the west wing of a building have its heating on.
explanation.definitionFit: Something heated has been made toasty, a plain synonym relation.

clue.text: Confirmed time and demonstrated, supporting American

indicators.note: in a down clue supporting means the following letters sit below, holding up the American letter

parts.note: tested in the sense of proved or shown by trial

explanation.surface: A report that someone's timing was checked and shown to back up an American.
explanation.definitionFit: To attest is to bear witness or certify, so it means verified or vouched for.

clue.text: Local dignitary of long ago put into service

indicators.note: put into tells you one word goes inside the other

parts.note: Mass is a church service
yore means times long past, as in days of yore

explanation.surface: A civic figure from history is drafted into service.
explanation.definitionFit: A female civic head of a town, or the consort of its chief, is a local dignitary.

clue.text: Big business keeping one's friends?

definitions.meaning: a firm that owns controlling shares in other firms
read literally, keeping hold of the people one spends time with

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a large firm is good at retaining its pals.
explanation.definitionFit: A parent corporation exists to own stakes in subsidiaries, so it is big business.

clue.text: Mother faces this having dropped one school subject

indicators.note: faces means stands in front of, so the mother word comes first

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother

indicators.note: having dropped says a letter is lost from the word before it

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A mother confronts this, having let one school subject go.
explanation.definitionFit: The British short form of mathematics, a core subject on any timetable.

clue.text: Row as they trained to be fit for voyage

indicators.note: trained means the letters are drilled into a new formation

explanation.surface: Rowers train in order to be ready for a long trip.
explanation.definitionFit: A vessel in good enough condition to sail safely is said to be fit for a voyage.

clue.text: Short of work experience

parts.note: under means less than or short of, as in under par
go means work or function, as in the machine won't go

explanation.surface: Someone lacking the work experience a job asks for.
explanation.walkthrough: 'experience' looks like a noun after 'work', but it is a verb meaning to go through.
explanation.definitionFit: To go through something, such as an operation, is to experience it; a verb synonym.

clue.text: Drug taker on target to be a consumer

indicators.note: in an across clue on means comes after, so the drug taker follows the target

parts.note: an end is an aim or target
a user is someone who takes drugs

explanation.surface: An addict on a mission to become a big spender.
explanation.definitionFit: The final person who buys or uses a product is its ultimate consumer, a marketing term.

clue.text: Alarmists seeing Germans score in a frenzy

indicators.note: in a frenzy means wildly agitated, so the letters are thrown about

explanation.surface: Doom-mongers watch a German team score and panic.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who spread fear or alarm are alarmists; a direct synonym.

clue.text: Tight-fisted dude is full of good intentions

parts.note: mean means stingy or tight-fisted
a swell is a fashionable dandy, also called a dude

explanation.surface: A stingy dandy who nonetheless has their heart in the right place.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes someone who has kind aims even if the result disappoints.

clue.text: Key recherché slang for a French delicacy

parts.note: Esc is the escape key on a computer keyboard
argot is specialised jargon, the obscure or recherché slang of a group

explanation.surface: An obscure slang term used to name a French dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Snails cooked in garlic butter are a celebrated French gourmet dish.

clue.text: Subjected to checks and filmed

definitions.meaning: vetted, as in examined for security or disease
shown on TV or at the cinema, as a film is

explanation.surface: A clue about someone vetted and recorded on camera.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses match: tested for problems, and broadcast or shown on a projection surface.

clue.text: Ring assistant and risk another shot at success

parts.note: a second attends a boxer in the boxing ring
to chance something is to risk it

explanation.surface: A boxer's helper gambles and gets another try.
explanation.definitionFit: A further opportunity to succeed after failing once; an idiomatic equivalent.

clue.text: Antacid needed by boxer after talk starts late

indicators.note: after means the boxer comes after the shortened talk word
starts late means the word begins later than usual, missing its first letter

parts.note: Muhammad Ali, the famous heavyweight boxer

explanation.surface: A boxer needs indigestion relief after a talk that starts late.
explanation.definitionFit: Antacids neutralise stomach acid; a base or alkali does exactly this chemically.

clue.text: An easy job producing wind

definitions.meaning: something done without effort, a doddle
a light wind or gust of moving air

explanation.surface: A task so simple it's like generating wind.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally an easy task is a cinch, and literally a gentle wind, both senses of one word.

clue.text: Maintained a voter originally made a mistake

indicators.note: originally means at the start, so the first letter is taken

parts.note: erred means made a mistake

explanation.surface: Someone insisted that a voter had got it wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: To aver is to declare firmly, so it means asserted or maintained.

clue.text: Play short on front of area

parts.note: a short is a small measure of spirits, a dram

indicators.note: front of means the first letter of the next word is taken

explanation.surface: A play falls short at the front of the stage area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' looks like an adjective but is the noun for a small whisky.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatrical play is a drama, a piece for performance on stage.

clue.text: Singer on vacation must carry more than enough music equipment

indicators.note: must carry tells you one part holds the other inside it
on vacation means emptied, so only the outer letters are kept

parts.note: ample means more than enough

explanation.surface: A holidaying singer has to lug plenty of musical gear.
explanation.definitionFit: A device that records and replays snippets of sound, used in music production.

clue.text: Scrambled egg in real drink

indicators.note: scrambled means jumbled, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A recipe for real scrambled egg.
explanation.definitionFit: A non-alcoholic fizzy beverage flavoured with spice, a kind of soft drink.

clue.text: Knowing of a fight prior to start of election

indicators.note: prior to means before, so those letters come first

parts.note: war means a fight or conflict

indicators.note: start of means the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Knowledge of a battle breaking out just before polling begins.
explanation.definitionFit: To be conscious of something is to know of it; a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Trend of current ideology

indicators.note: of means the letters are taken from within the following words

explanation.surface: A trend in present-day ideas.
explanation.definitionFit: A general drift or tendency, as in the turning of public opinion.

clue.text: Libyan ewer designed for beer

indicators.note: designed means freshly fashioned, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: A jug from Libya made for serving ale.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong, rich ale is brewed under this name, despite not being wine.
